title: Small Business Succession by State: Age of Employer-Business Owners (Census ABS)
description:
Share of employer-business owners aged 55-64 and 65+, plus family ownership, prior-business outcomes and firm/payroll context, for 50 states + DC and the U.S., from the Census Bureau Annual Business Survey (data year 2023).

Live page: https://familyestateguide.com/estate-planning-data/small-business-succession-by-state/. Published by Family Estate Guide.

Rights review: Excluded U.S. Bank 'Small Business Perspective' (2025) and JPMorgan Chase Local Snapshot Succession Survey (2026) statistics (e.g., 54% with a formal plan, 8% fully prepared). They are quoted on the live page but are copyrighted, bank-sponsored surveys with no open license; they were never in the CSV and are not in this repo.

Not legal, tax, financial or medical advice. Figures are estimates with sampling error; legal rules change. Verify anything important with the original source or a qualified professional.
